public_profile.coverage_note: UVC Partners reports more than €700 million in assets under management and €400 million in newly raised capital for founders in 2026; the €400 million figure is not firm-wide AUM. Its stated €150 million growth allocation and portfolio-level investment limits are fund strategy terms, not commitments to a particular company. UVC’s Atira announcement describes a $17.5 million total company round led by Accel and says UVC increased its prior investment; UVC’s individual contribution was not disclosed. The portfolio and performance examples are selected disclosures, not a complete audited record.
public_profile.summary: UVC Partners is a Munich- and Berlin-based European venture firm investing in B2B technology from early stages through growth. Founded in 2011, it focuses on DeepTech, ClimateTech, Mobility and Software/AI, and works closely with the UnternehmerTUM ecosystem. In 2026 the firm reported more than €700 million in assets under management and €400 million in newly raised capital for technology founders.

facts.label: Founded
facts.value: Founded in 2011; the firm says its partners collectively have more than 100 years of investing, exit and company-building experience.

facts.label: Locations
facts.value: Munich and Berlin, Germany; the headquarters is in Garching near Munich.

facts.label: Assets under management (firm-reported, 2026)
facts.value: More than €700 million, according to the firm’s March 2026 announcement.

facts.label: Newly raised capital (2026)
facts.value: The firm reported €400 million in newly raised capital for founders, including an additional €150 million earmarked for growth-stage investments. This is not the same as assets under management.

facts.label: Stages and investment sizes
facts.value: B2B technology investments from early stage through Series B and beyond. Initial tickets can reach €10 million; each fund can allocate up to €30 million to one portfolio company.

facts.label: Follow-on strategy
facts.value: The firm states that more than 50% of its funds are reserved for follow-on financing.

facts.label: Sector focus
facts.value: DeepTech, ClimateTech, Mobility, Software and AI.

facts.label: Selected portfolio companies
facts.value: The firm lists Flix, Isar Aerospace, planqc, Proxima Fusion, Reverion, Tacto, FINN and DeepDrive among portfolio examples.

milestones.description: UVC Fund IV completed its final close, according to the firm’s 2026 fund update.
The firm announced an additional €150 million growth allocation, bringing newly raised capital for founders to €400 million.
UVC Partners announced its participation in Atira’s $17.5 million round and said it increased its investment from the earlier pre-seed round.

track_record.description: Atira (September 2026): UVC Partners is listed as a participant in the company’s $17.5 million round, which was led by Accel. The disclosed amount is the company-wide round total, not UVC’s individual investment.
Atira (September 2026): UVC says it first invested in the company’s $2.5 million pre-seed round and increased its commitment in the later seed round; no individual check size was disclosed.

contacts.label: Munich office
